description: List current stock (`in_stock`) per variant per store. Filter by stores and/or variants — the answer to 'what is running low?'. Loyverse: GET /inventory.

cursor.description: The `cursor` from the previous page's response. Omit for the first page.

updated_at_max.description: Only levels updated at or before this time (ISO 8601 UTC, e.g. 2026-03-30T18:30:00.000Z).

updated_at_min.description: Only levels updated at or after this time (ISO 8601 UTC, e.g. 2026-03-30T18:30:00.000Z).

name: loyverse_list_inventory
title: List inventory levels
